name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: With $0 in paid spend across Meta and Google Ads over the last 28 days, Billy Doe Meats is running entirely on organic presence, where GBP drove 519 total actions including 38 calls, 79 direction requests, and 402 website clicks. The biggest movement is a 21.56% week-over-week increase in GA4 activity, likely driven by stronger organic or direct traffic to the site.

performance.verdict: Organic holding; paid relaunch is the only move that matters now.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all channels for the entire 28-day window — $0 Meta, $0 Google. No ROAS or purchase data exists to evaluate ecom efficiency.
SOW OVERDUE: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails all missed Aug 31 deadline.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for the last 7 days (prior 7d averaged ~33/day), a -100% delta — GBP data feed appears dark or stale since Sep 1.
GA4 sessions rose 21.56% week-over-week with 0 paid spend; last 3 days (Sep 4–6) averaged 318 vs prior 3 days (Sep 1–3) averaged 370 — the spike is fading without a paid driver.
8,058 GA4 sessions and 3,707 reported conversions over 28 days with 0 purchases recorded — Shopify purchase pixel is not firing; attribution gap is unresolved per known issue.

suggestions.text: Resolve 5 overdue SOW milestones — escalate to Nacer; each day of delay extends the paid-dark period.
